name: Klardaten (DATEV)
description: Klardaten API over a tax advisory firm's DATEV system: client master data, income, corporate and trade tax returns, bookkeeping (postings, SuSa, bank transactions), LODAS payroll, practice management analytics DATEV Anwalt legal files, DATEV users and groups, Eigenorganisation order updates and time entries (off by default), and a read-only DATEVconnect passthrough.
prerequisites: The Klardaten connector installed on the firm's DATEV server and a DATEV instance in the Klardaten dashboard. Tax and payroll data of the firm's clients: put this connector only on servers whose users may see all of it.
instructions:
**Sensitive data: read this first.** This connector reads a tax advisory firm's DATEV data through Klardaten: the master data, tax returns, bookkeeping and payroll of the firm's clients, including salaries, tax numbers, birth dates and bank transactions of private persons and companies. That data is covered by professional secrecy (§ 203 StGB, § 57 StBerG) and the GDPR. Add this connector only to servers whose users are allowed to see all of it, for example the partners or the staff who already have that access in DATEV. Do not add it to a shared or company-wide server. The API key acts with the DATEV profile behind it, so a model sees whatever that profile can read.

**Setup**
1. Sign in at https://dashboard.klardaten.com and create an API key for your user. It starts with `uk-` and goes into `KLARDATEN_API_KEY`; it is sent as `Authorization: Bearer`.
2. Copy the id of the DATEV instance (a UUID, created with your consultant number when the Klardaten connector was installed on the DATEV server) into `KLARDATEN_INSTANCE_ID`. Every DATEV request carries it in the `x-client-instance-id` header. `klardaten_list_instances` lists the instances the key can reach.
3. The Klardaten connector on the DATEV server must be running. When it is offline, DATEV calls fail while `klardaten_get_me` still works; `klardaten_get_datevconnect_health` shows the service status.

**Which tool to start with**: `klardaten_get_me` to check access, then `klardaten_list_clients` (master data), `klardaten_list_accounting_clients` (bookkeeping), `klardaten_list_payroll_clients` (LODAS payroll) or `klardaten_list_firm_clients` (the firm's own practice management analytics).

**Ids differ per area.** Master data uses UUIDs (`client_id`, `addressee_id`). Accounting uses a numeric `client_id` from `klardaten_list_accounting_clients`, and fiscal years are keyed by their start date as `YYYYMMDD` (e.g. `20250101`). Payroll and firm analytics use the `client_number`. Tax returns have their own `id`. Passing an id from another area is the usual cause of a 400 or 404.

**Paging, fields and filters**: list tools take `page` (from 1) and `page_size` (default 100), `order_by` (`field:asc|desc`, comma-separated), `fields` (comma-separated, keeps answers small) and `filter`. A filter is `field operator value` with `eq`, `like`, `gt`, `gte`, `lt`, `lte`, `in`, `notin`, `is`, `isnot`, combined with `AND`/`OR`, e.g. `client_id eq 101 AND fiscal_year eq 20250101`. Only the fields of that endpoint are accepted; an unknown field or a wrongly formatted value returns 400. Always filter `klardaten_list_postings` by `client_id` and `fiscal_year`: across all clients of a firm the query takes about a minute and can time out.

**Tax returns**: income tax, corporate tax, trade tax and VAT returns each have a list tool, a get tool and a data tool (`klardaten_list_vat_filings`, `klardaten_get_vat_filing`, `klardaten_get_vat_data` for Umsatzsteuer). `klardaten_list_clients_extended` returns clients with addresses, communications, tax office and bank accounts in one call; filter it, unfiltered it can time out.

**Monitoring**: when DATEV calls fail, check `klardaten_get_instance` (status, last reply), `klardaten_get_instance_required_services`, `klardaten_get_datevconnect_health`, `klardaten_get_instance_metrics` and `klardaten_list_instance_logs` (keep the time window short). `klardaten_list_audit_logs` and `klardaten_get_audit_log` show which accesses took place; `klardaten_list_data_change_webhooks` and `klardaten_list_monitoring_webhooks` list the configured notifications without their secrets. The DATEVconnect diagnostics (`diagnostics/v1/echo`, `diagnostics/v1/domains`) are read through `klardaten_datevconnect_get`.

**DATEVconnect passthrough**: `klardaten_datevconnect_get` reads any DATEVconnect GET path (e.g. `master-data/v1/clients`) for data the other tools do not cover. It is read-only.

**DATEV profile**: DATEVconnect calls run with the API key's default Klardaten profile. To act as another profile, set `KLARDATEN_PROFILE_ID`; it is sent as `x-profile-id` on every DATEVconnect call. Eigenorganisation writes need a profile that is an Eigenorganisation employee (`EODC10015` otherwise). `DCO10009` ("License for DATEVconnect is not present") comes from the DATEV server itself: check the DATEVconnect licence there.

**DATEV Anwalt and user management**: `klardaten_list_law_files` and the other `klardaten_*_law_*` tools read the law firm module (files, parties, budget, expenses and its reference lists); they need DATEV Anwalt on the server. `klardaten_list_datev_users` and `klardaten_list_datev_groups` read DATEV's user management (read-only).

**Writes (installed switched off)**: `klardaten_update_order` changes an Eigenorganisation order, `klardaten_create_expense_posting` books a time or cost entry on a sub-order, and `klardaten_set_client_responsibilities` replaces a client's responsibilities. They change the firm's DATEV data: turn them on only on a server whose users may do that in DATEV, and confirm every change with the user. `klardaten_update_order` and `klardaten_set_client_responsibilities` replace what they write, so read first and send the full object or list.

**Licensing**: the Enterprise endpoints (accounting, payroll, tax, analytics) depend on the Klardaten plan; an endpoint outside the plan answers 403. `klardaten_search_documents` needs the document search add-on, which Klardaten enables per instance on request; it is installed switched off, turn it on once the add-on is active.

KLARDATEN_API_KEY.label: API key
KLARDATEN_API_KEY.help: Klardaten dashboard → your user → API keys → create key. It starts with uk-. The key reads DATEV with your user's default profile.
KLARDATEN_API_KEY.patternMessage: A Klardaten API key starts with uk-.

KLARDATEN_INSTANCE_ID.label: DATEV instance id
KLARDATEN_INSTANCE_ID.help: The id of your DATEV instance in the Klardaten dashboard (a UUID). It is also returned by the instance list of the Klardaten API.
KLARDATEN_INSTANCE_ID.patternMessage: The instance id is a UUID, e.g. 48fa2446-c731-4a74-9ea7-b4bd6d66fe5f.

KLARDATEN_PROFILE_ID.label: DATEV profile
KLARDATEN_PROFILE_ID.help: Optional. The Klardaten profile to act as on DATEVconnect calls, sent as x-profile-id. Leave empty to use the key's default profile. Eigenorganisation writes need a profile that is an Eigenorganisation employee (DATEV answers EODC10015 otherwise).

verifyHints.401: Klardaten refused the API key. Create a new key in the Klardaten dashboard and paste it whole, starting with uk-.
verifyHints.403: The key works but may not read this DATEV instance or this data area. Check that your user is assigned to the instance and that the plan includes the Enterprise API.
verifyHints.bad_request: Klardaten rejected the request. Check that the instance id is the UUID of your DATEV instance.
verifyHints.unreachable: The DATEV server did not answer through Klardaten. Check that the Klardaten connector and DATEVconnect are running on the DATEV server.

tools.name: klardaten_get_me
tools.description: Return the user the API key belongs to and the effective access for the configured DATEV instance. Use it first to check that the key and instance id work.

tools.name: klardaten_list_instances
tools.description: List the DATEV instances (client instances) the account can reach, with id, name and consultant number. Use it to find the instance id for KLARDATEN_INSTANCE_ID.

unassigned.description: Include instances not assigned to the current user. Defaults to false.

include_deleted.description: Include deleted instances. Defaults to false.

tools.name: klardaten_list_clients
tools.description: List the advisory firm's DATEV clients (Mandanten) from master data: client_id, client_number, name, type, status, addresses, tax numbers and assignments. Start here to get a client_id or client_number.

order_by.description: Sort order as field:direction pairs, comma-separated, e.g. updated_at:desc,client_number:asc.

fields.description: Comma-separated list of fields to return, e.g. client_id,client_number,client_name. Leave empty for all fields; narrowing keeps answers small.

filter.description: Filter expression 'field operator value'. Operators: eq, like, gt, gte, lt, lte, in, notin, is, isnot. Combine with AND / OR and parentheses, e.g. client_status eq 1 AND client_name like Müller. Useful fields: client_number, client_name, client_status, client_type, updated_at.

tools.name: klardaten_get_datevconnect_health
tools.description: Return the latest service status changes of DATEVconnect on the configured instance (up to 100, last 30 days). Use it when DATEV calls fail or time out.

from_date.description: Start of the period, ISO 8601, e.g. 2026-10-01T00:00:00Z. Data is kept for 30 days.

tools.name: klardaten_get_usage_stats
tools.description: Return API usage of the configured instance in time bins: request count and average response time per status class.

from_date.description: Start of the period, ISO 8601, e.g. 2026-10-01T00:00:00Z. Data is kept for 30 days.

granularity_minutes.description: Bin size in minutes, at least 1.

tools.name: klardaten_get_instance
tools.description: Return the configured DATEV instance: name, consultant number, owner, connection type, status, time of the last reply from the DATEV server, connector version and whether it is a test instance. A first check when DATEV calls fail.

tools.name: klardaten_get_instance_required_services
tools.description: Return the state of the Windows services the configured DATEV instance needs (DATEVconnect, Klardaten connector and the DATEV services behind them). Use it when DATEV calls fail or time out.

tools.name: klardaten_get_instance_metrics
tools.description: Return load metrics of the DATEV server behind the configured instance over time: CPU and memory of the machine and of the connector process, database CPU, memory and I/O, and the number of requests waiting and in progress. Use it to explain slow answers.

from_date.description: Start of the period, ISO 8601, e.g. 2026-10-01T00:00:00Z. Keep the window short: answers grow quickly.

tools.name: klardaten_list_instance_logs
tools.description: Read the connector log of the configured instance, to find the cause of 5xx answers and time-outs. Returns log lines and a next_token; call again with next_token until it is missing. Narrow with filter_pattern and a short time window.

from_date.description: Start of the period, ISO 8601, e.g. 2026-10-01T00:00:00Z. Keep the window short: answers grow quickly.

filter_pattern.description: Text the log lines must contain, e.g. ERROR or a DATEV error code.

oldest_first.description: true returns the oldest lines first. Default: newest first.

tools.name: klardaten_list_audit_logs
tools.description: List the audit log files of the configured instance (name, size, last modified). They record which accesses to DATEV data took place. Read one with klardaten_get_audit_log.

tools.name: klardaten_get_audit_log
tools.description: Return the content of one audit log file of the configured instance as text. Files can be large; list them first with klardaten_list_audit_logs and pick the one for the day you need.

tools.name: klardaten_list_data_change_webhooks

tools.name: klardaten_list_monitoring_webhooks
tools.description: List the monitoring webhooks of the account: the endpoints notified when an instance goes offline or comes back. The signing secret is removed from the answer.

tools.name: klardaten_datevconnect_get
tools.description: Read any DATEVconnect endpoint through the Klardaten gateway (GET only), for data the other tools do not cover, e.g. master-data/v1/clients or accounting/v1/clients. Returns DATEV's own JSON.

path.description: DATEVconnect path without a leading slash, e.g. master-data/v1/clients or hr/v1/clients. See DATEV's DATEVconnect API documentation for the paths.

query.description: Optional query string without the leading ?, e.g. top=50&skip=0. Passed through to DATEVconnect unchanged.

tools.name: klardaten_search_documents
tools.description: Search the indexed DATEV DMS documents with a natural-language query in German or English and return the best matches with snippets. Needs Klardaten's document search add-on; installed switched off.

query.description: What to look for, e.g. Rechnung 471102 Lieferant GmbH.

top_k.description: Number of documents to return, 1 to 20. Defaults to 5.

include_chunks.description: Include the matched text passages. Defaults to false.

filters.description: Optional metadata filters, e.g. {"client_id": "..."}. Keys: client_id, dms_document_number, folder_id, register_id, extension, filename.

select.description: Comma-separated fields to return, keeps the answer small.

billed.description: true = billed only, false = open only.

filter.description: DATEV filter expression, e.g. contains(file_name, 'Muster') or file_number_short eq '000115-26'. Text values in single quotes.

select.description: Comma-separated fields to return, keeps the answer small.

tools.name: klardaten_get_order
tools.description: DATEV Eigenorganisation: read one order (Auftrag) in full. Read it right before klardaten_update_order and send the whole object back.

tools.name: klardaten_update_order
tools.description: DATEV Eigenorganisation: change an order (Auftrag). PUT replaces the order: read it with klardaten_get_order, change only the fields the user asked for and send the complete object. DATEV accepts changes to order_responsible1_id, order_responsible2_id, order_partner_id, completion_status (interrupted, done, resumed, work completed), planned_start, planned_end, planned_turnover, planned_hours_time_units, planned_time_costs, planned_expenses_costs, planned_material_costs and planned_external_costs. Writes to the firm's DATEV; installed switched off.

order.description: The complete order object as read with klardaten_get_order, with the intended changes.

tools.name: klardaten_create_expense_posting
tools.description: DATEV Eigenorganisation: book a time or cost entry (Aufwandsbuchung) on a sub-order. Creates a real posting and is not idempotent: after a timeout or 5xx, check the order's expense postings with klardaten_datevconnect_get (order-management/v1/orders/{order_id}/expensepostings) before retrying. The calling DATEV profile must be an Eigenorganisation employee (otherwise EODC10015); book only on open orders. Required: employee_id, work_date, cost_position. Time: time_units (1200 = 1 hour, 300 = 15 minutes), optionally start_time; day positions: number_of_days. cost_amount and number_of_units only for material, expense or third-party costs. By default the posting goes to the mass data entry (ZMA) for review; automatic_integration=true books it straight into the order. Installed switched off.

work_date.description: Date of work, as in DATEV's example DD.MM.YYYY 00:00:00, e.g. 19.10.2026 00:00:00.

time_units.description: Time units, 1200 = 1 hour, 300 = 15 minutes (positions measured in hours only).

start_time.description: Start time hh:mm:ss, only together with time_units.

number_of_days.description: Number of days (positions measured in days only).

cost_amount.description: Amount; only material, expense or third-party costs.

number_of_units.description: Quantity; only material or expense costs calculated by quantity.

fee_position.description: Invoice standard position; must exist in the sub-order and belong to the cost position.

object_number.description: Object number, when the same invoice position occurs more than once in the order.

automatic_integration.description: true = check and book straight into the order; false (default) = only write to the mass data entry for manual integration.

delete_mass_data_on_failure.description: Only with automatic_integration=true: true deletes failed records, false leaves them in the mass data entry for correction.

tools.name: klardaten_set_client_responsibilities
tools.description: DATEV master data: set the responsibilities (Zuständigkeiten) of a client. Replaces the complete list: read the current list first (klardaten_datevconnect_get with master-data/v1/clients/{client_id}/responsibilities), keep the entries that stay and send them all. Installed switched off.
